summary: Shared analytics wire events mapped to Adjust tokens and AppLovin MAX ad revenue.
manualSteps: Use Wizard Install to add Adjust SDK 5.8.2 and EDM4U 1.2.190 through OpenUPM; allow Unity package resolution to complete. Do not import another vendor copy.

Configure analytics.adjust.appToken as a nonblank 12-character string in bundled ConfigDefaults and analytics.adjust.environment as sandbox (default when absent) or production. Preflight rejects invalid token/environment. Map analytics.adjust.token.<wire_name> to Adjust event tokens.

Create AdjustAnalyticsInstaller.asset through Framework/Modules/Create Installer Assets or the Create menu, then slot it on RootLifetimeScope in the Master Scene through the live Unity Editor. Do not add an auto-starting Adjust component or initialize Adjust elsewhere.
For ad signals to be denied, configure analytics.adjust.adSignals = numeric 0 or string "0" before first analytics work. Absent means granted; this module never asserts eea.
Resolve EDM4U native dependencies and verify consent persistence, attribution, ad revenue and dashboard delivery on Android/iOS devices. SDK/native checks are not supplied by the headless suite.

privacy.forget_me is unsupported while Analytics is denied or the SDK is disabled/unstarted: false, with no start/re-enable for privacy. Active/granted bridge acceptance terminally refuses ordinary work/re-enables in this provider instance only; it is not proof of server deletion or acceptance across instances/native SDK/devices.
